title: EnableFighting - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to fight on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableFighting(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables the player's fighting controls. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable fighting myLayer.EnableFighting()
; Disable fighting InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableFighting(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsFightingEnabled - InputEnableLayer
